crossRefs.note: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh…
Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on…
This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of…
Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of…
The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Son of Machir; grandson of Manasseh; father of six sons.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Machir
people.line: Son of Manasseh; father (ie re-founder) of Gilead

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
translations.bsb: These were the descendants of Manasseh: The Machirite clan from Machir, the father of Gilead, and the Gileadite clan from Gilead.
translations.kjv: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
translations.asv: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir begat Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
